Mini-quiz A — napisz hasło po angielsku

Jak na egzaminie: definicja po angielsku → term.

1. to formally ask for a job or a place
 

2. a written request for a job
 

3. a letter sent with a CV to explain why you want the job
 

4. a document listing your education, skills and work history
 

5. a meeting where an employer asks you questions about a job
 

6. a person or company that pays people to work
 

7. a person who is paid to work for a company
 

8. without a paid job
